scope: SEC-01 focused before/after function integration on real local disposable MongoDB

cases.invariant: Valid reset preserves the existing response and atomically updates both records
Unknown token returns existing400 without password hashing or writes
Expired token is rejected before TTL deletion without writes
Already consumed token remains rejected
Sequential replay cannot overwrite a committed password
Two synchronized valid preflight reads permit exactly one successful reset
cases.failure: Two same-token consumers did not produce exactly one success and one400

cases.invariant: Three rounds of eight synchronized same-token requests have one winner each
cases.failure: A repeated eight-way concurrency round did not have exactly one winner

cases.invariant: Token-write failure leaves no partial password change and allows safe retry
cases.failure: An aborted reset left a committed password or consumed token

cases.invariant: User-write failure after a claim rolls back token consumption
Fault after the real user write but before commit rolls back both documents
cases.failure: An aborted reset left a committed password or consumed token

cases.invariant: Transient transaction failure retries the body with only one durable paired result
cases.failure: Transient failure was not safely retried

cases.invariant: Unknown commit acknowledgement retries commit without rerunning password writes
cases.failure: Unknown commit acknowledgement replayed the reset body or failed to retry commit

cases.invariant: Lost response after committed success cannot make a retry overwrite the password
Missing target user cannot return success or consume a token
cases.failure: Missing-user reset reported success or committed token consumption

cases.invariant: Expiry is rechecked after successful preflight and before transactional claim
cases.failure: Token expired after preflight was accepted

cases.invariant: A token consumed after preflight is rejected by the fresh claim
cases.failure: A token invalidated after preflight still changed the password

cases.invariant: Only the account bound to the token receives the password update
Unavailable transaction sessions fail closed without a standalone write fallback
cases.failure: Missing transaction support fell back to non-atomic writes

cases.invariant: Existing reset request model length requirements are preserved
Existing transaction helper really rolls back an aborted real Mongo write

limitations: Function bodies and model source are actual AST extraction;API decorators alone removed;not full HTTP routing/middleware integration.
Authentication throttle is an isolated no-op to keep this focused suite from changing or adjudicating SEC-04;old broader suite separately verifies it.
Collection fault wrappers forward actual Motor sessions and inject deterministic one-shot local errors;no global Mongo failpoint or provider call.
Commit-acknowledgement and session-unavailable paths are controlled client-boundary faults over the real replica-set session,not actual network outages or a standalone server.
